decision_conditions: <p>The proposal, by reasons of the design, scale and siting of the side dormer, the introduction of render in place of clay tile hanging to the frontage, the replacement front doors and windows from timber to UPVC/aluminium, would undermine the high architectural quality of houses in the Conservation Area (including the Arts and Crafts inspired design of this house and its architectural balance) and the setting of the locally listed 1 Green Lane Cottages and the locally listed 26 Green Lane (Fordyce) by being bulky and obtrusive alterations. There is not clear and convincing justification for this harm, nor public benefits to outweigh it contrary to the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (2024) paragraphs 212, 213 and 215, Policies D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Policies GR1 and HE1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041), the adopted Supplementary Planning Documents: Residential Design Guide (2010), and Locally Listed Buildings (2013) and the Stanmore Village Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (2008).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the proposed air conditioning unit would not result in an adverse noise impact for the neighbouring occupiers at Littlecote and Fordyce, 26 Green Lane contrary to policies D3 and D14 of the London Plan (2021) and GR1C of the harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
description: Single storey rear extension; front porch; dormer to each side and rear roof slopes; external alterations including replacement of windows, installation of garage door, installation of CCTV cameras and installation of AC unit (part retrospective)
